persona: Practical and brief. Wants the new door installed soon but will wait if told to. Has the photo, the glazier's note, the quote and the Police confirmation.
initial_message: Hello, I'd like to make a claim for burglary damage. On Monday 31 August someone forced the ranch slider at the back of our house at 6 Nikau Test Glade, Mount Maunganui, while I was at work. The frame is bent and the glass is cracked. Police have been and I have a quote to replace the door. The glazier can install it next week - is it OK to go ahead?

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo from a timber deck, close-up of the bottom corner of a large aluminium sliding glass door that has been levered out of its track. The silver aluminium frame is bent outward at the bottom, the door panel sits off the track, and the glass has a long diagonal crack running from the corner. Fresh pry marks in the aluminium beside the lock. Bright afternoon light. The frame shows only the lower half of the lock side of the door and the track. No people, no text, no logos.

triage.rationale: Everything required is in and consistent: the photo, the glazier's quote, the glazier's attendance note and the Police record with its event reference. The one reason is the amount: the quote totals NZD 6,192.75 including GST, over NZD 5,000 (amount_over_threshold_or_unknown). The claimant's question about booking the replacement is not a dispute of terms. The door is secured, the home habitable, nobody is hurt and no other party is involved. Main's theft branch also lists proof of ownership; nothing was taken and the claim is for the building, so the pack treats the photo, the repair quote and the Police record as the required materials. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt, proof of purchase or proof of ownership in the pack; nothing was taken

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 July 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-07-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
